independence.later_comparison: Compare this frozen pool-first result with the separate 200-wallet operator study only after both are complete.

hypothesis: Young, volatile, lower-TVL SOL-paired DLMM pools may offer materially greater gross LP revenue density and activity per deployed dollar than the >=$50k universe.

pool_universe.pagination: Each TVL stratum is paginated independently so low-TVL pools are not censored by a global TVL-desc page cap.
pool_universe.completeness: Every TVL stratum must reach the API-reported final page within the fixed 100-page bound; otherwise the study fails closed rather than compare a censored stratum.

volatility_sampling.selection: Deterministic SHA256(address) ascending among pools with positive 24h volume; never selected by fee yield, volatility, or later outcome.

interpretation.primary_question: Do lower-TVL strata show materially higher gross fee/activity density and a stronger concentration of young/high-volatility pools?
interpretation.later_wallet_confirmation: Separately test whether final profitable operators from the 200-wallet study deploy into and earn PnL in the same strata.

amendment_history.reason: Increase page size to the documented API maximum and require complete per-stratum pagination before any pool-first comparison.
